answer: Emission dilution resists sybils: each epoch a fixed reward pool is split pro-rata across all miners, so spawning clones mints no new coin—it only thins every share, like diluting one jar of pigment until the color fades to nothing. A thousand fakes each take a thousandth; the reward math is a cipher that always resolves to zero net gain. Any pooled advantage drains away like rain through karst, leaving no reservoir behind, so quantity buys nothing and sustained original work is the only real edge.
